description: This file defines the ScheduledJobDetailRepository interface, which extends JPA repository interfaces to manage ScheduledJobDetail entities, including custom queries for retrieving job details, locking, and existence checks within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ScheduledJobDetailRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ScheduledJobDetail entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByJobKey
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail by its job key.

methods.name: findByJobId
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail by its ID.

methods.name: findByJobKeyWithLock
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail by job key with a pessimistic write lock.

methods.name: findAllMismatchedJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs marked as mismatched.

methods.name: findAllJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs for a given node ID or with node ID zero.

methods.name: findByJobName
methods.description: Finds a job detail by its name.

methods.name: getDataById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed job data by job ID.

methods.name: getDataByShortName
methods.description: Retrieves detailed job data by short name.

methods.name: existsByShortName
methods.description: Checks if a job exists with the given short name.

methods.name: findIdByShortName
methods.description: Finds the ID of a job by its short name.
